headline: The UE4 tangent / bi-normal / smoothing-group warnings are NOT caused by degenerate triangles. Measured on the real production tiles, geometry is clean (0 degenerate, 0 zero-area, 0 sliver faces in 18,708 triangles). The cause was that the FBX files carried no UV channel and no smoothing groups, so every face necessarily had a degenerate tangent basis under MikkTSpace. The fix has now been executed in Blender 4.3 and verified: both layers are present in the regenerated FBX, with byte-verified channel deltas and exact geometry parity.

root_cause.defect: No UV channel anywhere in the pipeline output.
measured_evidence_before: OBJ (OSM2World output): 0 'vt' records in both tiles
Blender manifest: uv_layers == 0 on all 303 (tile 10-9) and 263 (tile 6-6) objects
blender_convert.py: use_tspace=False, so no explicit tangents were exported either
root_cause.consequence: UE4 must derive tangents with MikkTSpace from UVs. With zero parametric area on every face, all 18,708 faces had a degenerate tangent basis and a near-zero bi-normal.
maps_to_warnings: has degenerate tangent bases which will result in incorrect shading
root_cause.verified_fix: LayerElementUV went 0 -> 1132 across the two regenerated tiles (606 for tile 10-9, 526 for tile 6-6), matching the object counts exactly.

root_cause.defect: No smoothing groups in the FBX, because mesh_smooth_type='OFF' writes no LayerElementSmoothing node.
root_cause.note: Fully independent of the UV problem.
root_cause.verified_fix: LayerElementSmoothing went 0 -> 1132 across the two regenerated tiles after switching mesh_smooth_type to 'FACE'.

tangents_deliberately_not_exported.why: Governed policy is not to export tangents that cannot be independently validated offline. Shipping unvalidated tangents would trade the current warning for a different one. UE4/MikkTSpace derives them from the now-valid normals and the newly generated UV channel, which is the documented-correct path.
tangents_deliberately_not_exported.note: use_tspace=False was never the defect; the defect was the absent UV channel, which MikkTSpace needs regardless of whether tangents are imported.

geometry_parity.claim: the fix added vertex channels without altering geometry
geometry_parity.tile_10_9: faces 8443 -> 8443, vertices 5544 -> 5544 (exact match vs baseline manifest)
geometry_parity.tile_6_6: faces 10265 -> 10265, vertices 6508 -> 6508 (exact match vs baseline manifest)
geometry_parity.faces_removed: 0 on both tiles, as predicted, because the source geometry was already clean
geometry_parity.significance: This is the strongest safety property of the change: no silhouette, no vertex count and no triangle count moved.

fbx_roundtrip.significance: The regenerated FBX re-imports into a clean Blender with a byte-for-byte identical inventory, so the new UV and smoothing layers did not corrupt the file.

tile_10_9.delta: 2 (from Blender's distance-based vertex merging on import)

smoothing_policy_independently_recompute.significance: The 63% sharp ratio is genuine, not blanket-sharpening: all 5022 sub-degree (coplanar) edges were correctly left smooth, so hard edges appear only at real corners.

bug_found_and_fixed_during_verification.description: sanitize_mesh runs before validate_mesh and deletes unrepairable faces. Because validation then saw nothing wrong, the gate reported PASS even when faces had been removed. The governed policy requires PASS / REPAIRED / REJECTED, so an altered mesh was indistinguishable from a pristine one, and the 660 s-class failure mode of 'repair quietly amputates a building' was unguarded.
fix: validate_mesh now returns PASS / REPAIRED / REJECTED based on what was changed, not only on what survived.
Added MAX_REPAIR_FRACTION = 0.02: if more than 2% of faces were removed, escalate to REJECTED so heavy deletion can never be laundered as a repair.
Dormant edge dissolution alone also yields REPAIRED.
Aggregate run gate uses precedence REJECTED > REPAIRED > PASS.
REPAIRED is logged as QUALITY_REPAIRED so it is visible in stdout, not only in the manifest.
Every verdict now records gate_reasons for provenance.
bug_found_and_fixed_during_verification.regression_tests_added: tests/unit/test_blender_geometry_contract.py::TestGateIsExecutable executes the emitted decision logic directly (5 cases) in addition to 8 source-level assertions.
bug_found_and_fixed_during_verification.note: Before this fix the earlier unit tests passed while the real behaviour was wrong: they asserted on source text rather than on the executed verdict.

hypotheses_tested_and_refuted.hypothesis: Degenerate or zero-area triangles cause the warnings.
hypotheses_tested_and_refuted.refuted_by: 18,708 measured triangles: 0 repeated-index, 0 zero-area, 0 collinear, 0 sliver. Minimum face area 1.9e-3 m^2. Confirmed a second time by the Blender run: faces_removed = 0 and degenerate_triangles = 0.
hypotheses_tested_and_refuted.consequence: No triangle-repair heuristics were tuned, because there is nothing to repair.

hypotheses_tested_and_refuted.hypothesis: float32 FBX precision collapses vertices and creates degenerate geometry.
hypotheses_tested_and_refuted.refuted_by: GEOMETRY_PRECISION_AUDIT.json: the float32 round trip merges 16 duplicate vertices but creates 0 zero-area and 0 collapsed triangles; minimum area moves only from 1.9218e-3 to 1.9211e-3 m^2.
hypotheses_tested_and_refuted.note: The first draft of that audit reported RISK because it counted merged duplicate vertices. That metric was wrong: OBJ legitimately emits the same corner from several faces. The audit was corrected to measure triangle degeneracy.

hypotheses_tested_and_refuted.refuted_by: OSM_BUILDING_REPAIR_REPORT.json: all 5,711 pinned elements are geometrically valid, 0 defects of any class, 5,711 placed and 0 unplaceable.
hypotheses_tested_and_refuted.validation_of_the_audit: The detector was checked against 5 synthetic defective rings (consecutive duplicates, self-touching, two distinct vertices, collinear, unclosed) and flagged every one, so the clean result is not vacuous.

fix.principle: Generator stage only. No warning suppression, no MikkTSpace disabling, no road topology change, no tile-membership change, no final-artifact cosmetic mutation.
stages: sanitize_mesh: delete only unrepairable faces (<3 verts or area <= 1e-12 m^2); dissolve edges < 1e-6 m. Slivers are kept and counted.
recompute_normals: every vertex gets a usable unit normal. Tangents are still not exported.
generate_uvs: per-object box projection - the actual fix for the tangent/bi-normal warnings.
apply_smoothing: smooth all faces, mark edges sharp above a 30 degree dihedral angle plus all boundary edges.
validate_mesh: re-measure geometric and UV triangle areas with the offline gate's thresholds and return PASS / REPAIRED / REJECTED.
fix.provenance_added: manifest.quality_policy and manifest.geometry_quality, including per-object quality detail with gate and gate_reasons
